title: GBPUSD M30 Take-Profit 1 Expansion (22.0 Pips) to Remedy Payout Asymmetry
research_question: Does widening InpTP1Pips from 15.0 to 22.0 pips on GBPUSD M30 increase average winning trade payout and eliminate the 1:3 payout asymmetry, maintaining 2020-2024 training profitability with profit factor >= 2.50 and maximal drawdown <= 5.0%?
hypothesis: Increasing InpTP1Pips from 15.0 to 22.0 pips while holding InpMaxSLPips constant at 15.0 will increase the realized reward on TP1 partial scale-outs by ~46.7%, improving payout symmetry without severely degrading win rate below 65.0%.

facts: EXP-0034 (Training 2020-2024) achieved PF 3.20 with 78.1% win rate, but average win was $16.92 vs average loss -$18.83 across partial scale-outs.

EXP-0048 (2026 UNSEEN) suffered catastrophic regime failure (PF 0.62, -$592.46 net loss, 11.17% drawdown) when win rate dropped to 52.94%, because average loss (-$97.53) was 1.81x average win ($53.78).
Closing 50% volume at 15 pips while absorbing full 15-pip stop losses requires a mathematical breakeven win rate of >= 75.0% when continuation runners do not develop.
inferences: Expanding InpTP1Pips to 22.0 pips allows 50% scale-out to bank 11.0 effective pips before moving to break-even, shifting the payout profile closer to 1:1 risk/reward.
If the market can reach 22.0 pips with sufficient frequency (> 65%), the strategy will survive lower win-rate regimes without breaching drawdown limits.

independent_variables.name: InpTP1Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Widening Take Profit 1 from 15 to 22 pips increases banked partial profit by ~46.7%, mitigating the 1:3 payout asymmetry.

assumptions: GBPUSD M30 swings have sufficient momentum to reach 22 pips during London/NY sessions.
Deriv-Demo tick and execution quality is consistent with historical runs.
expected_observations: Average profit trade increases from ~$53 to >= $70.
Total net profit across 2020-2024 training remains >= $500.00.
falsification_conditions: Win rate collapses below 60.0% due to price turning before 22 pips.
Total net profit turns negative (< $0.00) or profit factor drops below 1.50.
